integrity: Proof by exact cosine dual slack, spectral norm bound, and equality diagonalization; finite floating-point tests are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric nonnegative stochastic tridiagonal kernels and uniform invariant distribution only.
The coefficient in the energy estimate is exact; the resulting individual edge bounds need not have best constants.
Relevant original sources were inspected; an equivalent theorem may exist elsewhere.
title: Sharp squared-SLEM rigidity and equality cases for fastest mixing on paths
